9364dc7518.q: What is the tax cost increase for business acquisitions completed after April 5 2026?
9364dc7518.a: If a business acquisition is completed after April 5th 2026 with a sale price of £1 million or more, it will cost an additional £30,000 in tax compared to completing before that deadline. This change in the capital gains tax regime accelerates the timing for acquisition completions.
